changeTypeExplanation: A database major-version migration changes the storage layer every tenant's data lives in (SCN-CSO-EVA).
changeDescription: SCN-2026-004: migrate the managed PostgreSQL database tier to the next major version.
reason: The current major version reaches the cloud provider's end of support in March 2027.
customerImpact: A 30-minute read-only window per region; no agency configuration changes are needed.

planAndTimeline.summary: Rehearse in staging, migrate the secondary region, verify, then the primary. The assessor re-validates SC-28 and CP-9 after cut-over.

milestones.milestoneDescription: Primary region migrated and assessor validation complete
